تستأمرون (form X)
# تَسْتَأْمِرُونَ (tastaʔmirūna) /tas.taʔ.mi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْمَرَ (istaʔmara)
# تُسْتَأْمَرُونَ (tustaʔmarūna) /tus.taʔ.ma.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْمَرَ (istaʔmara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
